proposals.title: Fossil fuel financing
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy ensuring JPMC financing does not contribute to new fossil fuel supplies inconsistent with the IEA Net Zero by 2050 Scenario.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Special shareholder meeting improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending governing documents so owners of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles with an independent Chairman who is not a former CEO.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Board diversity resolution
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring initial director candidate lists to include qualified diverse candidates and publication of nominee skills matrices.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Conversion to public benefit corporation
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board amend charter to convert the company to a public benefit corporation in light of the Business Roundtable Statement.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on setting absolute contraction targets
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report setting absolute contraction targets for financed greenhouse gas emissions consistent with UNEP FI recommendations for credible net zero commitments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
